description: Off-by-one error in pagination logic and incorrect loop boundary
diff:
diff --git a/api/pagination.py b/api/pagination.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/api/pagination.py
+++ b/api/pagination.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+def paginate(items, page, page_size):
+    """Return a page of items."""
+    start = page * page_size
+    end = start + page_size
+    return items[start:end]
+
+def get_last_page(total_items, page_size):
+    """Return zero-based index of the last page."""
+    # BUG: should be (total_items - 1) // page_size
+    return total_items // page_size
+
+def find_first_above_threshold(values, threshold):
+    """Return first value above threshold."""
+    for i in range(len(values) - 1):  # BUG: misses last element
+        if values[i] > threshold:
+            return values[i]
+    return None
